frame.axes: x = easting - originE; z = originN - northing (north is -z); y = DEM height in metres

boundarySource: Queensland Spatial Cadastral Fabric lot parcel 1SP353650 (surveyed, B&D plot controlled +/- 0.25 m)
elevationSource: Queensland Elevation DEM Public Time Series, bare-earth terrain raster
clearedAreaSource: Traced from the open ground in the parcel aerial, registered to the cadastral corners
padSource: Pale concrete or rubble patch traced from the parcel aerial; fitted rectangle
easementSource: Queensland Spatial Cadastral Fabric easement parcels on SP353650; purposes are not published there
roadSource: Carriageway edges traced from the parcel aerial; edges hidden by canopy are interpolated at the measured width
groundSource: Queensland DEM exported at 2 m around the lot

constraints.source: Sunshine Coast Planning Scheme 2014 overlays and 2023 flood mapping (council), queried 2026-09-27; slope from the state LiDAR DEM at a 5 m scale; setbacks assumed
